# Normalization_WeightDecay_Coupling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The coupled effect of normalization layers and weight decay regularization, which together can create non-convex loss landscapes with critical points. This coupling affects the stability of gradient-based learning in distributed TCC/iNEST architectures, where communication delays and topology changes can exacerbate such effects.
